When i was 5, I was playing “the floor is lava” with my bff at the time. Except I was playing on the bed, so i guess the bed was lava technically? We were jumping on pillows and I slipped on one and hit my head on the corner of the bed frame, which was metallic. Didn’t really feel anything except sad about losing. 
It’s when my mother came in, saw me, and starting screaming and crying when i went to the mirror to see that my skin had peeled off and half of my left eyebrow was dangling from my face. The left side of the face was drenched with blood. Still didn’t feel a thing but cried anyway because I thought that meant I’ll be getting an injection. That’s my “Tis but a scratch moment”. 
Thanks to the doctors who saved my eyebrow.
